reason: The named independent lab and the batch report behind the QR code are exactly what I check before buying, and the 200 mg dose is written out. At $24.99 with a money-back guarantee I would try one box, but I would not stock up.
objection: Only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule, and I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles. Made in China also makes me want to open the lab report myself before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report for the batch turned out not to match the box or was not really there, or if reviews showed stomach problems or people not finishing the box, I would pass.
